# Otter MCP Server

Connect AI models to Otter using Model Context Protocol (MCP). Connecting Otter MCP to your AI applications enables secure, scalable access to various language model understandings to power features like smarter summaries, contextual suggestions, and automated insights for all your Otter conversations and meetings.

## What is Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

MCP is an open standard that allows AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT
to securely access external data sources. With Otter’s MCP Server, these AI
assistants can:

✅ Search your meeting transcripts across all time periods

✅ Analyze patterns and themes across multiple meetings

✅ Generate content using your actual meeting data

✅ Surface insights without leaving your AI workflow

🔑 **Key advantage:** Your meeting knowledge becomes instantly accessible to AI
assistants, eliminating manual copy-paste and context-switching.

🔒 **Security:** All access is OAuth-authenticated with granular permissions.
Your AI assistant can only access meetings you explicitly authorize.

## Claude setup Learn how to set up Claude

**Check out** [**Otter.ai in the Claude connectors directory**](https://claude.ai/directory/connectors/otter-ai)**.**

Connect Otter MCP to Claude.

1. Go to **Settings → Connectors → Browse connectors.**

   **Note:** If your workspace admin has already added Otter.ai, it will appear as an available connector. Click **Connect** and proceed directly to Step 3.

   ![](https://help.otter.ai/hc/article_attachments/40107242368023)
2. [Go to Claude's Otter.ai page](https://claude.ai/directory/connectors/otter-ai) and click **Connect.**

   ![](https://help.otter.ai/hc/article_attachments/40107242369047)
3. Sign in to your Otter account. Review the info and click **Authorize access** to connect with Claude.

   ![](https://help.otter.ai/hc/article_attachments/40107249840279)
4. Otter MCP is connected to Claude.![](https://help.otter.ai/hc/article_attachments/40107242373271)

### Enable Otter MCP tool with chat

Click on the **search and tools** menu in the chat box. Toggle on **Otter.**

![](https://help.otter.ai/hc/article_attachments/40107242374167)

Claude will prompt for permissions when querying using Otter MCP tools.

![](https://help.otter.ai/hc/article_attachments/35471827382167)

You can manage permissions for the Otter MCP tool in the connector settings.

1. Under the settings **Connectors,** click **Configure** next to Otter or manage through the 3-dot menu.

   ![](https://help.otter.ai/hc/article_attachments/40107242375959)
2. Manage each of the tools' permissions. We recommend setting it to **Always allow**.![](https://help.otter.ai/hc/article_attachments/40107242380567)

## ChatGPT setup Learn how to set up ChatGPT

Connect Otter MCP to ChatGPT. Otter.ai is available in the ChatGPT App Store.

**Check out** [**Otter.ai in the ChatGPT App Store**](https://chatgpt.com/apps/otter-ai/asdk_app_695d84e2f06c8191861b9bac9b3fd53b)**.**

Enable Otter MCP tools with ChatGPT. Now that Otter is connected, you can work from the ChatGPT web browser or the desktop app.

- Click the** + (plus icon).** Click **••• More** and select **Otter.ai**.
- Type **@** and select **Otter.ai**.

When starting a new chat, make sure **Otter.ai** is showing. If you do not see otter.ai, select it again through the steps above.

![](https://help.otter.ai/hc/article_attachments/38994810578711)

### Using Otter MCP tools with ChatGPT

Otter uses 3 tools in ChatGPT to query your meetings:

- **fetch**
- **get user info**
- **search**

If prompted, accept the tool request to proceed.

![](https://help.otter.ai/hc/article_attachments/38994810580119)

You can click any source to go directly to the Otter conversation.

![](https://help.otter.ai/hc/article_attachments/38994810581527)

If you are experiencing any issues querying your Otter conversations, we recommend specifically mentioning the Otter tool you want to use in your query.

![](https://help.otter.ai/hc/article_attachments/35998845100311)

Manage Otter MCP settings for ChatGPT in **Apps.**

![](https://help.otter.ai/hc/article_attachments/38982398977303)

## Cursor setup Learn how to set up Cursor

Connect Otter MCP to Cursor. [Refer to Cursor’s documentation on connecting MCP servers for more info](https://cursor.com/docs/context/mcp).

1. Navigate to Cursor settings. Click **Tools & MCP.** Click **Add Custom MCP.**

   ![](https://help.otter.ai/hc/article_attachments/35525952787223)
2. Configure the JSON file with the following. **Save changes to the file**.

   ```json
   {
     "mcpServers": {
       "otter_meeting_mcp": {
         "url": "https://mcp.otter.ai/mcp"
       }
     }
   }
   ```
3. Navigate back to **Tools & MCP.** Click **Connect**.

   ![](https://help.otter.ai/hc/article_attachments/35525952789143)
4. Click **Open**.

   ![](https://help.otter.ai/hc/article_attachments/35525952793111)
5. Sign in to your Otter account. Click **Authorize access.**

   ![](https://help.otter.ai/hc/article_attachments/35525952795287)
6. Otter MCP is connected to Cursor.

   ![cursor otter is connected.png](https://help.otter.ai/hc/article_attachments/35525952797719)

### Enable Cursor

Enable Otter MCP by ensuring it's toggled **ON** under Cursor **Tools & MCP** settings and tools enabled. Cursor will automatically use available tools.

![](https://help.otter.ai/hc/article_attachments/35525958457623)

If a tool is disabled, click on the grayed-out tool to re-enable.

![](https://help.otter.ai/hc/article_attachments/35525952802839)

## Perplexity Learn how to set up Perplexity

Connect Otter MCP to Perplexity using custom connectors to securely access and reference your Otter conversations, meeting notes, and AI insights directly within Perplexity.

**Note:** Perplexity’s UI may change over time. Refer to [Perplexity’s documentation](https://www.perplexity.ai/help-center/en/articles/13915507-adding-custom-remote-connectors) for the latest instructions on connecting a custom connector.

1. Navigate to the [**Connectors**](https://www.perplexity.ai/computer/connectors)settings page. The location may vary depending on whether you are using an individual or an Enterprise account.
2. Click **+ Custom connector.**

   ![](https://help.otter.ai/hc/article_attachments/40457986987287)
3. Configure using the following settings and click **Add.**
   - Name:** Otter.ai**
   - Description: **Meetings from Otter**
   - MCP server URL: `https://mcp.otter.ai/mcp`
     ![](https://help.otter.ai/hc/article_attachments/40457986988951)

     **Icon:** The Otter icon can be downloaded here.
4. Sign in to your Otter account and click **Authorize access.**

   ![](https://help.otter.ai/hc/article_attachments/40457986989335)
5. Otter MCP is connected to Perplexity.

### Enable Perplexity

Make sure the connector is enabled before submitting your query. You may need to grant permissions the first time you use the provided tools.

![](https://help.otter.ai/hc/article_attachments/40457986989847)

## Connect Otter MCP to other AI tools You may be able to connect Otter MCP to your AI tool depending on your platform

Otter MCP can be connected to third-party AI tools that support the Model Context Protocol (MCP) using a JSON configuration file. Setup varies by platform and is managed entirely within your AI tool’s configuration. Configuration, behavior, and support depend on the specific platform you are using. Refer to your tool's documentation to connect to an MCP server.

### Before you begin

- Your AI tool must support MCP
- You should be familiar with editing JSON configuration files
- OAuth authentication is still required to connect

### JSON Configuration file

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "otter": {
      "url": "https://mcp.otter.ai/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

### Complete setup in your AI tool

1. Add a custom MCP and configure the JSON file with the above.
2. Connect and authenticate with your Otter account.
3. Verify the Otter MCP server appears, and tools are available.

**Note:** We’ll continue adding step-by-step guides for more AI tools. In the meantime, setup may vary by platform and is completed at your discretion.

---

## Tools overview

| Name | Description | Sample prompt |
|---|---|---|
| **Get user info** | Get the current user's name and email. This tool retrieves the authenticated user's profile information, including their name and email address. | “What is my email address?” |
| **Search** | Search for meetings and get an overview of information. | "Which meetings related to product improvement did I attend in Q2?" |
| **Fetch** | Retrieves a full speech transcript of a meeting or conversation. | "What are the three main focus areas based on marketing meetings with our Enterprise clients?" **“**Summarize the presentation https://otter.ai/u/NpsJNrxvrcDay0dnlPKPZM87OSo?tab=chat&view=summary” |

### **Fetch example**

Query direct conversation URLs. Copy an Otter conversation URL from the browser.

**Note:** The conversation must be [shared with you](https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/360048338793) for your AI application to access the content.

![](https://help.otter.ai/hc/article_attachments/35535766146071)

Try it out by replacing the following with your own conversation link:

> Summarize the presentation https://otter.ai/u/NpsJNrxvrcDay0dnlPKPZM87OSo?tab=chat&view=summary

## Examples & usage

Query conversations, pull highlights and key details, and generate content based on your meetings.

![](https://help.otter.ai/hc/article_attachments/35472494699031)

**Examples**

> Generate a PowerPoint based on meeting XYZ.
>
> In which meetings did we discuss mobile navigation UX?
>
> Pull all meetings in Q3 discussing sales initiatives and the top ideas.

### Advanced Use Cases

| **Competitive Intelligence Analysis** | “Analyze all Q4 customer calls mentioning competitors. What are the top 3 feature requests we’re losing deals over?” |
|---|---|
| **Onboarding Acceleration** | “Pull highlights from all sales training meetings in the last month. Create a structured onboarding doc with key processes and best practices.” |
| **Executive Briefings** | “Summarize the key decisions and action items from all leadership meetings this week. Format as a Friday exec briefing.” |
| **Cross-Functional Alignment** | “Compare what Product and Sales are saying about our Q1 roadmap. Identify any misalignments or gaps in messaging.” |
| **Historical Context Retrieval** | “What did we decide about the pricing model in our August strategy meeting? Pull the exact discussion and reasoning.” |
| **Meeting Prep Intelligence** | “I have a call with Acme Corp tomorrow. Pull all previous meetings with them and summarize: current status, open issues, and key stakeholders.” |

## FAQs

## Is Otter MCP available for all AI applications?

## Is Google Gemini supported?

## What meetings can I access through the MCP Server?

- You can access all meetings that you have captured in Otter, as well as any meetings shared with you from other users in your Workspace.
- Learn more about [conversation sharing](https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/360048338793) and [Channels](https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/360049379794) in Otter.

## Can I connect Otter MCP on the ChatGPT desktop app?

- Connecting Otter MCP on ChatGPT desktop app is not yet available. Connect Otter MCP on the web version of ChatGPT.

## Is there a public API key for me to set up Otter MCP for my AI application?

- We currently do not have a public API key at this time. Contact our [Otter Support team](https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/1500000001541) for help setting up Otter MCP with your AI application.
